evidence.title: Abortion pill access jumps almost 50% after Australia eases restrictions for pharmacies

occurrences.checkable_against: Therapeutic Goods Administration prescribing rules before 2023
occurrences.quote_span: Prior to the changes, GPs needed additional training and registration to prescribe it.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme listing for MS-2 Step
occurrences.quote_span: MS-2 Step, available under the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme, comprises two drugs used together, mifepristone and misoprostol.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Prof Kristina Edvardsson's quoted statement
occurrences.quote_span: “If you can go to your local pharmacy and pick up this medication, it means getting care quicker.”
occurrences.speaker: Prof Kristina Edvardsson
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Studies cited by Prof Kristina Edvardsson and abortion procedure statistics
occurrences.quote_span: Edvardsson said other studies have found improving access to MS-2 Step is safe, and that when access to the medical abortion pill increases, the need for surgical abortion decreases.
occurrences.speaker: Prof Kristina Edvardsson
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: JAMA Network Open study and Australian pharmacy ordering records
occurrences.quote_span: The number of Australian pharmacies stocking an abortion pill increased by almost 50% when prescribing restrictions were relaxed, with researchers saying the findings suggest deregulation of abortion promotes safer and faster healthcare.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Pharmacy ordering records analyzed in the JAMA Network Open study
occurrences.quote_span: There were 2,228 pharmacies stocking it before the policy change, rising to 4,107 by mid-2025.
occurrences.speaker: La Trobe University researchers
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Therapeutic Goods Administration prescribing eligibility rules
occurrences.quote_span: Appropriately trained nurse practitioners and endorsed midwives also became eligible prescribers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: JAMA Network Open study and regional and remote pharmacy coverage data
occurrences.quote_span: Regional coverage increased from 23% to 35% of postcodes, while the proportion of stocking pharmacies in remote areas nearly doubled, rising from 12.5% to 22%.
occurrences.speaker: La Trobe University researchers
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: JAMA Network Open study and pharmacy ordering data
occurrences.quote_span: By comparing pharmacy ordering data in the two years before and after the changes, researchers led by La Trobe University found by mid-2025, 49% more pharmacies were stocking the medication.
occurrences.speaker: La Trobe University researchers
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: JAMA Network Open study and Therapeutic Goods Administration regulatory records
occurrences.quote_span: A study published in the medical journal JAMA Network Open on Thursday examined the impact of changes by the Therapeutic Goods Administration in 2023 which meant the medication, MS-2 Step, could be prescribed by any GP.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: MS-2 Step product information and Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme listing
occurrences.quote_span: It can be taken until up to 63 days of gestation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Research by Dr Anna Noonan on abortion-care access
occurrences.quote_span: Noonan said there was still work to be done to improve rural and regional access, and that her own research suggested a lot of “invisible work” also occurred by local doctors, nurses and advocates working behind the scenes so that people can confidentially and more easily find healthcare.
occurrences.speaker: Dr Anna Noonan
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Dr Anna Noonan's research and pharmacy stocking records
occurrences.quote_span: “Doctors and nurses are going to pharmacies in advance saying, ‘I’m going to be an abortion provider in this community, will you stock this medication?’
occurrences.speaker: Dr Anna Noonan
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: European abortion statistics and Australian medical versus surgical abortion statistics
occurrences.quote_span: “In some European countries, medical abortion accounts for more than 90% of all abortions, and it looks like we’re heading that way here as well with a steady increase in medication abortion versus surgical abortion,” she said.
occurrences.speaker: Prof Kristina Edvardsson
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Prof Kristina Edvardsson's statement in the study coverage or study authorship record
occurrences.quote_span: The lead author of the paper, Prof Kristina Edvardsson from La Trobe University’s school of nursing and midwifery, said it showed “Australian women who need access to this medication can access it closer to home”.
occurrences.speaker: Prof Kristina Edvardsson
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: JAMA Network Open study and Australian postcode pharmacy coverage data
occurrences.quote_span: The number of postcodes with a pharmacy stocking the medication rose from 915 to 1,292 – or nearly half of all Australian postcodes – two years after the changes.
occurrences.speaker: La Trobe University researchers
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Therapeutic Goods Administration dispensing and administrative rules
occurrences.quote_span: The requirement for pharmacists to be registered to dispense the drug was also scrapped, and administrative hurdles were relaxed.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Prof Kristina Edvardsson's quoted statement
occurrences.quote_span: “It removes the unnecessary travel and stress around getting the medication once it’s prescribed. That’s super important, particularly for women who might be more disadvantaged, women living in rural, remote areas, and women who might not have the means to travel.
occurrences.speaker: Prof Kristina Edvardsson
occurrences.subject: Impact of Australian abortion pill prescribing deregulation
